verdict.rationale: Codex documents delegating tasks to isolated cloud environments that run in parallel in the background ('Delegate a longer task and return when it is ready'). Tasks can be started from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack, and `codex exec` provides a non-interactive mode for repeatable workflows and CI pipelines. These are one-off background runs, though: there is no first-party recurring schedule or standing 'automation' feature, so any recurring trigger comes from external CI or the host platform. missing for 10: native scheduled/recurring automations, documented event-triggered standing automations, independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Delegate a longer task and return when it is ready.

Start work in Codex cloud from GitHub pull requests, GitLab merge requests and issues, Linear issues, or Slack channels and threads.
Use Codex interactively or call codex exec from repeatable workflows and pipelines.
